title: 第19章 异化第20章 异端头子
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 宁语自然也跟着珲伍进入了雾门。
她目睹了整场酣畅淋漓的战斗演出，尽管珲伍跳过了过场动画，但就和对话一样，跳过了，但也确实发生过。
这场战斗与双方数值无关，纯粹是为了塑造猎龙者形象而设计的。
所以即使珲伍现在是极致超重的状态，他也依旧可以在演出中打出完美的战斗效果。
当然，珲伍只是陪衬，大部分时间里猎龙者在耍帅。
不过，虽然猎龙者那一身玄铁重甲以及头盔里深邃的漆黑十分骇人，手中猎龙长矛和盾牌大开大合的英姿伟岸，但宁语大部分时间的目光还是聚焦在珲伍身上。
无它，只因她现在是迷妹状态。
珲伍前后掏出来的那两枚禁忌符文已经完全收买了她的灵魂。
所以最后长矛在即将钉死珲伍的时候停了下来，紧张半天的宁语也终于狠狠是地舒了一口气。
刚到手的老师要是这么快就领了盒饭，她可能得哭死。
而结束战斗之后的猎龙者像是大梦初醒一般，盯着珲伍胸口上的太阳契约徽章愣了许久。
最后收起长矛转身离去，全程一言不发。
这时候的猎龙者还没有对话选项。
准确地说，已经迷失过的她可能连对话所需的思维都没有，只有猎杀的本能。
珲伍身上的太阳契约徽章相当于是在告诉她，咱俩是一伙的。
所以她放过了珲伍，但也仅是本能在驱使着她这么做。
在后续的很长一段时间里，猎龙者会持续处于这种混沌状态，不断地凭着本能在大陆南方猎杀龙血者。
首先遭殃的就是龙墓盆地里那些走地龙。
等她思维渐渐复苏一些之后，就轮到如今世道上那些龙飨教会的教徒挨她的长矛了。
反正也是一场相当唬人的血雨腥风，等她与珲伍再次相遇了才会触发后续剧情，不过那都是后话了。
猎龙者那宛如小巨人般的身躯迈着沉重的步伐，顺着地下岩层通道另一端的出口缓步离开了这座洞窟。
宁语看着那高大威猛的背影逐渐消失在视野尽头，一丁点儿追赶拦截的念头都生不起，小跑着来到珲伍身边，把半截身子埋在碎石里的珲伍搀了起来。
“您没事吧老师！”
珲伍摆摆手，起身之后开始卸掉自己身上的甲胄，恢复之前的丐帮造型。
一切都在计划之内。
如果他没有穿戴上这一整套太阳战士的甲胄，演出动画结束之后他会被直接捅个半死，血条大概只会剩下那么一丝，身体的大部分生机都会丧失，且一朝回到最初那副活尸模样。
那样的话，先前消耗的人性旧印就直接浪费了。
而现在则不一样，看起来被揍得很狼狈其实一滴血都没有掉，依旧是满血状态。
“老师，那个人也是死诞者吗？”
宁语不愧是小天才，一下子就察觉出了端倪。
猎龙者本身的意志并不清晰，而且身上携带着非常古老、陈旧的气息，只有灵魂波动非常强烈，这和最开始珲伍从墓群里被掏出来的时候非常相似。
“可能是吧。”
珲伍不置可否。
他并不想在一条没有结果的剧情支线上浪费脑细胞，猎龙者之所以重要，是因为她是直接引出后续大陆南部的世界线大事件的导火索，她本人的故事并不值得深究。
content_en:
Ning Yu naturally followed Hui Wu into the fog gate.
She witnessed the entire hearty battle performance. Although Hui Wu skipped the cutscene, it was just like the dialogue, skipped, but it did happen.
This battle has nothing to do with the numerical values ​​​​of both sides. It is purely designed to shape the image of the dragon hunter.
So even though Hui Wu is now extremely overweight, he can still achieve perfect fighting effects in the show.
Of course, Hui Wu is just a foil, and the dragon hunter is acting cool most of the time.
However, although the dragon hunter's dark iron heavy armor and the deep darkness in the helmet were very frightening, and the dragon hunting spear and shield in his hands were opened and closed, Ning Yu's eyes were still focused on Hui Wu most of the time.
It doesn't matter, just because she is a fan girl now.
The two taboo runes that Hui Wu took out one after another had completely bought her soul.
So in the end the spear stopped when it was about to nail Hui Wu, and Ning Yu, who had been nervous for a long time, finally breathed a sigh of relief.
If the newly arrived teacher received the lunch box so quickly, she might cry to death.
After the battle, the dragon hunter seemed to be waking up from a dream, staring at the sun contract badge on Hui Wu's chest for a long time.
Finally, he put away his spear and turned away, without saying a word the whole time.
At this time, Dragon Hunter has no dialogue options.
To be precise, she may not even have the thinking required for dialogue as she has been lost, only the instinct to hunt.
The sun contract badge on Hui Wu's body is equivalent to telling her that we are on the same team.
So she let Hui Wu go, but it was only instinct that drove her to do so.
For a long time to come, the dragon hunters will continue to be in this state of chaos, constantly relying on instinct to hunt the dragon-blooded ones in the south of the continent.
The first to suffer were the earth-moving dragons in the Dragon Tomb Basin.
After her mind gradually recovered, it would be the turn of the followers of the Dragon Feast Church in today's world to suffer from her spear.
Anyway, it was a pretty scary and bloody scene, and the subsequent plot would not be triggered until she and Hui Wu met again, but that was all for another time.
…
The dragon hunter's body, which was like a little giant, took heavy steps and slowly left the cave along the exit at the other end of the underground rock passage.
Ning Yu watched the tall and mighty back gradually disappear from the end of her field of vision. She couldn't think of chasing and intercepting him at all. She jogged to Hui Wu's side and helped Hui Wu up, who was half buried in the gravel.
"Are you okay, teacher!"
Hui Wu waved his hands, stood up, and began to take off his armor, returning to his previous beggar appearance.
Everything is according to plan.
If he hadn't put on this set of Sun Warrior armor, he would have been stabbed half to death after the animation ended, with only a trace of his health bar left, most of his body's vitality would have been lost, and he would have returned to his original living corpse appearance.
In that case, the old seal of humanity previously consumed would be directly wasted.
But now it's different. It looks like he was beaten very embarrassed, but actually he didn't lose a drop of blood, and he is still full of blood.
"Teacher, is that person also a Deathborn?"
Ning Yu was indeed a little genius, and he immediately noticed the clues.
The dragon hunter's own will is not clear, and he carries a very ancient and outdated aura. Only his soul fluctuates very strongly, which is very similar to when Hui Wu was first taken out of the tombs.
"Maybe so."
Hui Wu was noncommittal.
He didn't want to waste his brain cells on a fruitless plot line. The reason why the dragon hunter was important was that she was the trigger that directly led to major events in the world line in the southern part of the continent. Her own story was not worth delving into.
